story.text: That night, in his gloomy rooms, Scrooge hears the {CLANKING} of a chain. Through the locked door comes the ghost of Jacob {MARLEY}, wrapped in cash-boxes, keys and {PADLOCKS}. “How now?” says Scrooge, {CAUSTIC} and cold as ever. “I wear the chain I {FORGED} in life,” the ghost answers. Scrooge may yet {ESCAPE} his fate: three {SPIRITS} will come.
story.caption: “How now?” said Scrooge, caustic and cold as ever
